prospective_contrast: At fixed u and h, compare histories with the same mean but different age-weighted sums, such as [1,0,0,0] versus [0,0,0,1]. Their predicted responses differ through H1 and H2; equality within calibrated error would refute the retained recency-sensitive history representation.

quantities.interpretation: Oldest prior drive, four seconds before the current time.
quantities.name: H1

quantities.interpretation: Most recent prior drive, one second before the current time.
quantities.name: H2

refutation_condition: Reject this representation if prospective matched conditions show RMSE above 0.06 or if same-mean early-versus-late histories have indistinguishable responses within the 0.015 response-unit calibration bound.
scientific_change: Replace the instantaneous-only response assumption with explicit dependence on the oldest and most recent prior drives. The observed matched-input contrasts show strong history effects and distinguish history ordering; the intermediate history entries are not yet established as necessary.
